messages:
Incident Bot: Pager -> P1: elevated 5xx rate on /v1/generate in eu-west1 (since ~10m). Alert: error_rate > 3% for 2m. Please acknowledge.
Jae Park: acked. I'm on it — checking logs and recent deploys.
Maya Chen: looking at canaries + LB metrics, seems spike aligns with a small rollout around 09:12 UTC.
Andre Gomez: rolling back the last canary now. will update when done.
SRE Rotation: FYI customer-facing monitoring shows a subset of requests timing out, reaching retries and then 500s. Potential backpressure from KV-cache miss storm.
Jae Park: rollback successful, traffic shifted back to stable. errors dropped a bit but still above baseline.
Maya Chen: making a quick dashboard slice: https://dash.redwood/boards/alerts/175932 — adding error distribution by model & sequence length.
Andre Gomez: I see sustained errors from long-seq requests (>1024). runtime logs show OOM-ish traces on a few instances.
SRE Rotation: scaling affected pool up 2 nodes to relieve pressure.
Jae Park: temp mitigation in place (scale + rollback). Are we paged because of noise from low-impact spikes? what's the customer impact?
Customer Success Bot: Alert triggered; 12 customer requests observed failing in the last 10m. No major accounts flagged yet.
Maya Chen: impact is limited but noisy. I'd recommend silencing the low-priority alert group for the short window while we stabilize metrics and then tune thresholds.
Andre Gomez: agreed. proposing: silence rule "api.error_rate_lowprio_eu" for 30m and open a followup to adjust threshold from 3%->7% on sustained burst-only alerts.
Jae Park: please do the silence but only the low-priority channel, keep oncall-high for real degradations.
Infra Tooling: applied silence: api.error_rate_lowprio_eu for 30m (by @Infra Tooling).
Incident Bot: Silence applied by Infra Tooling.
SRE Rotation: adding short maintenance window 09:40-10:30 UTC to prevent chattiness while we validate rollout.
Maya Chen: capturing the alert expression we want to change — current PromQL: | increase(api_request_errors_total{route="/v1/generate",region="eu-west1"}[2m]) / increase(api_requests_total{route="/v1/generate",region="eu-west1"}[2m]) > 0.03 |
Maya Chen: proposed: require both longer window AND minimum volume: (increase(...[5m]) / increase(...[5m])) > 0.07 and increase(api_requests_total[5m]) > 500
Andre Gomez: will draft PR to infra-alerts repo with that change + unit tests against historical traces. PR: https://git.redwood/infra/alerts/pulls/412
Jae Park: important: validate new threshold against last 90d historical data to ensure we don't hide regressions during low-traffic hours.
Maya Chen: I'll run historical backtests this morning. adding the notebook and results to the incident ticket.
SRE Rotation: assigning follow-up task: ALERTS-927 (adjust rule, add noise exemption for canaries, update runbook threshold section). Owner: Andre. Due: 3d.
Andre Gomez: filing ALERTS-927 now.
Andre Gomez: quick note — while silenced, we MUST keep the oncall-high channel enabled for errors > 15% or > 2000 errors/min. That preserves safety.
Jae Park: agreed — can we add a fallback rule in the PR? if error_rate > 0.15 for 1m -> page critical.
Infra Tooling: added fallback alert (error_rate > 0.15 for 1m) to the draft PR as separate rule.
Incident Bot: Post-incident recap: rollback + scale reduced errors to baseline by ~22m after start. No major customer outages.
Customer Success Bot: Notified CS slack and queued a bulletin for affected customers (low-impact advisory).
Maya Chen: Postmortem notes: root cause likely interaction between recent canary change + long-seq memory amplification. We'll include mitigation & ownership in the postmortem doc.
Jae Park: Follow-up checklist: 1) Merge PR with threshold + fallback + canary exemption. 2) Run historical validation (Maya). 3) Add automated smoke test for long-seq workload during canary deploys (SRE Rotation). 4) Postmortem + notify customers (CS).
Andre Gomez: I've added the test stub to infra-tests: `tests/smoke/long_seq_canary.yml` — need approval from SRE.
SRE Rotation: will review and land test by EOD.
Maya Chen: Results from historical backtest: proposed threshold (7% on 5m & min 500 reqs) would have suppressed ~40 low-noise alerts in last 90d and would have still fired for the 3 real incidents. attaching CSV to ALERTS-927.
Jae Park: perfect. please add a sanity check to CI that prevents threshold regressions (e.g., new threshold must not increase median false negatives on historical set).
Infra Tooling: noted, will add test in PR.
Incident Bot: Closing temporary silence for api.error_rate_lowprio_eu (expired).
Andre Gomez: once PR merges, I'll schedule a 2h maintenance window tomorrow 08:00-10:00 UTC to validate in staging and then roll to prod.
Customer Success Bot: CS update sent: customers informed of advisory; no action required.
Jae Park: thanks all. Postmortem owner assigned: Maya. Please drop final link to postmortem here when ready.
Maya Chen: will publish postmortem and remediation PR links by COB today.
SRE Rotation: handing back to rotation, marking incident as resolved for now. :white_check_mark:
